import sys
from collections import OrderedDict
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
ws = wb["Budget"]

cat_totals = OrderedDict()
grand_total = 0
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=11, max_row=22, max_col=3):
    cat, item, amt = row[0].value, row[1].value, row[2].value
    amt = amt if isinstance(amt, (int, float)) else 0
    grand_total += amt
    cat_totals[cat] = cat_totals.get(cat, 0) + amt

print("Per-category totals:")
for cat, total in cat_totals.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {total}")
print(f"Grand total expenses: {grand_total}")
print(f"Sheet formula C23 cached value: {ws['C23'].value!r}")
